subject.title: fix(volcengine): normalize escape sequences in tool call arguments (#114292)

question: Should escape-sequence normalization be enabled for every Volcengine model, or only for the confirmed Deepseek V4 Flash routing until broader transport evidence exists?
rationale: The patch changes the compatibility behavior of all Volcengine models, while the available report and proof identify only one model route; that compatibility scope cannot be safely inferred from unit tests.

options.title: Restrict to the confirmed route
options.body: Gate decoding to the identified Deepseek V4 Flash model or an equivalent verified compatibility signature, then expand only with provider evidence.

options.title: Approve provider-wide normalization
options.body: Accept that all Volcengine models share the double-escaping behavior and document the resulting intentional-literal-content tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Restrict to the confirmed route
recommendation.body: Gate decoding to the identified Deepseek V4 Flash model or an equivalent verified compatibility signature, then expand only with provider evidence.
